name: Rochelle Elliot
original_name: ロシェル・エリオット
source: Like Elsa, he serves as a soldier of the Republic, and despite his youth, has already attained the rank of lieutenant. While attending Tenkyo Imperial Academy, he interacts with Sojin as a classmate. Well-versed in the culture of the Imperial Kingdom, he treats its citizens on equal terms with republicans. His friendly yet elusive personality often leaves others—especially Sojin—struggling to understand him, sometimes leading to trouble.
